column4:
When Car Wash mode is on, Park Comfort turns on, climate switches to recirculation, and all windows, the trunk and the charge port lid close. These are disabled: keyless entry, charge port lid switch, auto wipers, obstacle alerts, walk-up unlock / walk-away lock.

Note: Car Wash mode exits automatically above 15 km/h.

Automatic car wash: keep battery above 20% and do not move the car, otherwise Car Wash mode exits when the driver leaves. For conveyor car washes, fold the mirrors and shift to N. Stay in the car; leaving it shifts to P.
column5:
洗车模式激活后，将开启驻车舒享，空调切为内循环，关闭所有车窗、后备箱、充电口盖；并禁用以下功能：无钥匙进入开关、充电口盖开关、自动雨刮器、障碍物报警、接近解锁/远离上锁。

注：若车速大于15公里/小时，将自动退出洗车模式。

自动洗车提示：请确保电量大于20%并且不要移动车辆，否则主驾人员离车后洗车模式会自动退出；使用传送带洗车机请翻折后视镜，挂入N挡，人员请勿离车，离车时挡位会切换P挡。
